more_info.overview: Black PN is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Refined food-use estimates were generally below EFSA's 2010 limit.
Some high-consumption estimates for children exceeded it. Laboratory DNA findings did not establish a cancer effect.
